name: Fengrine
description: Fengrine was a Mid Rim agriworld situated in the Senex sector. A prestigious agricultural center that was the most powerful of the agricultural worlds of the Senex-Juvex region, by the time near the end of the Galactic Republic it had also become one of the largest exporters of foodstuffs in the galaxy.
